text: dsh-session-autarchive 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话管理插件：它由宿主定时扫描本地会话，并在侧栏加入保护标记和通用设置天数入口。会话超过设定天数后可自动归档，默认阈值为五天；已归档、置顶或加入保护名单的会话会跳过。用户可在会话右键菜单标记单条会话不自动归档，也可通过设置调整天数，并查看行首盾牌提示。宿主工具还可查看候选、立即归档或试运行。它读取本机 DSH 会话并在 DSH_HOME 下保存状态，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-session-autarchive archives idle DSH sessions, skipping pinned or protected ones. Users can mark a session in the sidebar and change the idle threshold in settings. State is stored locally; no API key or external service is needed.
想把长期没活动的 DSH 会话自动归档，减少侧栏里的旧会话。
能不能给某个会话加个保护标记，让自动归档跳过它？
I want old inactive sessions archived automatically while pinned or protected sessions stay in place.
dsh-session-autarchive 的功能「闲置会话自动归档」：宿主按最后活动时间筛选超期会话，默认阈值五天，并跳过已归档、置顶或受保护的会话；可定时运行，也可通过工具立即执行或试运行。
dsh-session-autarchive README · dsh-session-autarchive： **中文** | [English](README.en.md) 把长期没动过的会话自动归档。按会话内最后一条对话结束的时间算天数，默认 5 天；已归档、置顶（可关）、标记「不自动归档」的都跳过。侧栏会话右键菜单给单个会话加标记，通用设置里改天数。

dsh-session-autarchive README · 界面上的三处：| 位置 | 样子 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话右键菜单 | 与「置顶会话／重命名／分叉会话／归档会话」并列的一行「不自动归档」 | 点一次标记，再点一次取消 |
| 会话行首 | 被标记的会话多一个小盾牌 | 一眼看出这条不会被自动归档 |
| 悬停卡片 | 一行「不会被自动归档」 | 同上，带文字说明 |
| 通用设置 | 最底一行「自动归档天数」 | 失焦或回车即保存，写的是宿主同一个字段 |

dsh-session-autarchive README · 判定与执行：- **判定**：扫 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<工作区>/session-*` 目录，解出会话档里最后一条 `turn/end`（对话结束）事件的时间当「最后活动」；超过阈值（默认 5 天）、未归档、不在保护名单、非置顶（置顶豁免默认开）的就是待归档的会话。只是被打开/恢复过不算活动——恢复会话会往档里追写开场提示，所以文件写入时间不作判据；解不出事件时退回文件最后写入时间。刚写过不到 1 小时的会话本轮跳过。
- **执行**：宿主每 10 分钟跑一轮（启动 60 秒后第一次，窗口没开也照常跑）；浏览器半边每 5 分钟拉一次待归档清单，拿到官方归档通道就当场归档，侧栏立即刷新。
- 归档走官方 `archiveSession`，不是删数据。归档后的会话在侧栏归档列表里，可以恢复。

dsh-session-autarchive README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:taoziliyouchong/dsh-session-autarchive
```

装完重启 DSH。用别的 profile 就把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名。

兼容：DSH 0.2.1 系列（alpha / rc / 正式版均可）；0.3 起不保证。

发布到 npm 之后也可以：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-autarchive
```

dsh-session-autarchive README · 工具：工具名 `dsh-session-autarchive`，五个动作：

| action | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| `status`（默认） | 配置摘要、当前待归档会话、保护名单、最近一次执行 |
| `run` | 立刻归档当前待归档会话；`dryRun: true` 只列清单不动手 |
| `protect` | 标记单个会话「不自动归档」（要 `sessionId`） |
| `unprotect` | 取消标记 |
| `config` | 改 `days`（天数）、`enabled`（开关）、`exemptPinned`（置顶是否豁免） |

dsh-session-autarchive README · 数据文件：都在 `$DSH_HOME/session-autarchive/`：

| 文件 | 写它的地方 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `protected.json` | 只有 protect／unprotect | 保护名单的唯一来源。自动归档那条定时链不碰它，怎么跑都洗不掉标记。 |
| `state.json` | 定时归档、config | 开关、阈值、置顶豁免、最近一次执行结果；不存名单。 |
| `audit.log` | 名单改动、每轮归档 | 一行一条，标记哪天没了可以对着时间查。 |

写入一律「临时文件 + 改名」，读盘失败会重试——不会把半截文件当成「没有名单」再把默认值写回去。

dsh-session-autarchive README · 机制：- 宿主半边注册四条本机路由：`GET /dsh-session-autarchive/api/state`、`POST .../protect`、`POST .../config`、`POST .../run`。只接受回环地址（`127.*`、`::1`、`::ffff:127.*`），远程访问一律 403；方法不对 405。
- 浏览器半边用 `ctx.slots` 挂四个座位（菜单行、行首、悬停、设置行），服务探测一律 `ctx.get`，拿不到就跳过，不影响其他入口。
- 不联网、不上传任何内容；判定只用本地文件时间。

dsh-session-autarchive README · 已知限制：- 宿主侧没有 `workspaceRegistry` 服务时，只能列出待归档会话、不能自己归档；此时由浏览器半边走官方通道执行。
- 只扫 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下的会话档；不在这个目录里的会话不参与判定。
- 不要与另一个自动归档插件同时安装：同一组界面座位只能挂一份，重复安装会出现两行菜单和两行设置。
- 默认开启：装好就会按 5 天阈值归档。想先观察，把 `enabled` 改成 `false`，或把 `days` 调大。

dsh-session-autarchive README · 开发：源码分两半：

- `index.js` —— 宿主半边（判定、归档、四条路由、工具）
- `src/entry.jsx` —— 浏览器半边（菜单行、行首盾牌、悬停说明、设置行、5 分钟快通道）

改过 `src/entry.jsx` 必须重新打包。`lib/client.js` 是提交进仓库的构建产物，缺了它界面不会加载：

```sh
npm install
npm run build:client    # 重新生成 lib/client.js
npm run check:client    # 比对新产物与已提交产物是否一致
npm run smoke           # 结构 / 组合声明 / 注册 / 鉴权 / 状态读写 / 产物

冒烟全程用临时 `$DSH_HOME`，不读也不改你的会话数据。打包要求：`react` 与 `react/jsx-runtime` 保持 external（由 DSH 客户端模块表提供）；产物外壳 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 里的 `id` 必须等于包名。

dsh-session-autarchive README · dsh-session-autarchive： [中文](README.md) | **English** Archives sessions that have gone unused for longer than a configurable number of days (5 by default). Archived sessions, pinned sessions (exempt by default), and sessions marked "do not auto-archive" are skipped. A session context-menu item marks a single session, and a field in General settings changes the threshold.

dsh-session-autarchive README · Where it shows up：| Where | What it looks like | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Session context menu | One row, "Do not auto-archive", next to Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive | Click once to mark, again to unmark |
| Session row start | A small shield on marked sessions | Shows at a glance that the session is protected |
| Hover card | One line, "Not auto-archived" | Same, with text |
| General settings | A row at the bottom, "Auto-archive after (days)" | Saved on blur or Enter, writes the same host field |

dsh-session-autarchive README · How it decides and runs：- **Decision**: scan `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace>/session-*` directories and read the time of the last `turn/end` (end of a conversation turn) event inside each session log as "last activity". Sessions older than the threshold (5 days by default), not yet archived, not on the protected list, and not pinned (pinning is exempt by default) become pending sessions. Merely opening or resuming a session does not count: resuming appends the opening prompt to the log, so the file write time is not used; when no event can be read, the file write time is the fallback. Sessions written to within the last hour are skipped for that round.
- **Execution**: the host runs a round every 10 minutes (the first one 60 seconds after start, so it keeps running even with no window open); the browser half polls the pending list every 5 minutes and archives through the official channel when it is available, so the sidebar updates immediately.
- Archiving goes through the official `archiveSession` call. It does not delete data: archived sessions stay in the archive list and can be restored.

dsh-session-autarchive README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:taoziliyouchong/dsh-session-autarchive
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Replace `desktop` with your own profile name if you use another one.

Compatible with the DSH 0.2.1 line (alpha / rc / stable); 0.3 and later are not guaranteed.

Once published to npm, this also works:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-autarchive
```

dsh-session-autarchive README · Tool：The tool is named `dsh-session-autarchive` and takes five actions:

| action | What it does |
|---|---|
| `status` (default) | Configuration summary, pending sessions, protected list, last run |
| `run` | Archive the pending sessions now; `dryRun: true` lists them without touching anything |
| `protect` | Mark one session "do not auto-archive" (needs `sessionId`) |
| `unprotect` | Remove the mark |
| `config` | Change `days`, `enabled`, `exemptPinned` |

dsh-session-autarchive README · Data files：All under `$DSH_HOME/session-autarchive/`:

| File | Written by | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `protected.json` | protect / unprotect only | The single source of the protected list. The archive timer never writes it, so a run cannot wash the marks away. |
| `state.json` | archive rounds, config | Switch, threshold, pin exemption, last run result; holds no list. |
| `audit.log` | list changes, every round | One line each, so a lost mark can be traced by time. |
dsh-session-autarchive README · Data files：Writes are temp-file-then-rename, and reads retry — a half-written file is never mistaken for "no list" and overwritten with defaults.

dsh-session-autarchive README · How it works：- The host half registers four local routes: `GET /dsh-session-autarchive/api/state`, `POST .../protect`, `POST .../config`, `POST .../run`. Loopback addresses only (`127.*`, `::1`, `::ffff:127.*`); anything else gets 403, a wrong method gets 405.
- The browser half mounts four slots (menu row, row start, hover card, settings row). Services are probed with `ctx.get`; when one is missing that entry is skipped and the others still mount.
- No network access, nothing uploaded. Decisions use local file times only.

dsh-session-autarchive README · Known limits：- Without a `workspaceRegistry` service on the host side, the host can only list pending sessions and cannot archive by itself; the browser half then executes through the official channel.
- Only sessions stored under `$DSH_HOME/sessions` are considered.
- Do not install another auto-archive plugin alongside this one: the same UI slots can only be claimed once, and duplicates show the menu row and the settings row twice.
- Enabled by default: it starts archiving at the 5-day threshold right after install. To watch first, set `enabled` to `false` or raise `days`.

dsh-session-autarchive README · Development：The source has two halves:

- `index.js` — host side (decision, archiving, four routes, the tool)
- `src/entry.jsx` — browser side (menu row, row shield, hover line, settings row, the 5-minute fast path)

Editing `src/entry.jsx` requires rebuilding. `lib/client.js` is a build artifact committed to the repository; without it the UI does not load:

dsh-session-autarchive README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build:client    # regenerate lib/client.js
npm run check:client    # verify the committed artifact matches the source
npm run smoke           # structure / bundle manifest / registration / authorization / state / artifact

dsh-session-autarchive README · Development：The smoke run uses a temporary `$DSH_HOME`; it never reads or changes your session data. Build rules: keep `react` and `react/jsx-runtime` external (the DSH client module table provides them); the `id` inside the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` envelope must equal the package name.
